originalIntent: MUTCD Part 6 temporary traffic control. A work-zone scenario in which the ego drives through the devices is not a work-zone scenario; contact with a cone is a failed negotiation. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Work zone: the ego must negotiate the closure without striking the channelizing devices
